content.title: CarMax CEO abruptly steps down, Peloton recalls 800K+ bikes
content.description:
Market Domination host Josh Lipton and Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Allie Canal take a look at some of Thursday's trending tickers and stories.

CarMax (KMX) CEO Bill Nash has stepped down, with board member David McCreight stepping up as interim CEO.

Bumble (BMBL) was downgraded to Sector Perform from Outperform by RBC.

Peloton (PTON) has recalled 833,000 bikes.
